about.title: About Date Difference Calculator
about.description: The Date Difference Calculator computes the time span between two dates, showing results in years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, and seconds. It is useful for age checks, project durations, anniversaries, and general time-period analysis. This tool provides multiple output formats for planning and reference workflows.

faq.q: Can I calculate date differences for past dates?
faq.a: Yes, our date difference calculator works with any date combination - past, present, or future dates for comprehensive time span analysis. Perfect for calculating historical periods, ages, or project durations.

faq.q: How does the date difference calculation work?
faq.a: The calculator applies standard calendar rules, including leap years and varying month lengths, to show the time span between two dates. Review the output if you need results for formal, legal, or contractual use.

faq.q: Does the calculator show business days only?
faq.a: Yes, you can view the difference in business days, excluding weekends and optionally holidays from the calculation. This is perfect for project management and work-related time calculations.

faq.q: What if I enter the dates in wrong order?
faq.a: The date difference calculator automatically handles date order and will show the absolute difference between the two dates regardless of input order. No need to worry about which date comes first.

faq.q: Can I calculate someone's exact age with this tool?
faq.a: Absolutely! The date difference calculator is perfect for calculating exact ages in years, months, and days. Simply enter the birth date and current date to get precise age calculations.

faq.q: Does the calculator work for project duration planning?
faq.a: Yes, the date difference calculator is excellent for project management. Calculate project durations, milestone gaps, and timeline analysis with options for business days to exclude weekends from your planning.
